Slamming his front door shut with a resounding bang, Austin slips off his shoes and jacket to set them down nicely where they are supposed to go. He makes his way through his small, mysterious stains, bug infected studio apartment before throwing himself down on the mattress he has on the floor — no point buying a bed frame when he will end up breaking it anyways.

He opens his phone up and checks out the latest matches he got on Tinder, hoping to find someone to fuck for the night, or anything to kill the empty silence in his place. Austin scrolls through his phone aimlessly, not even bothering to see who he was accepting or rejected until he came across one profile he never thought he would see.

"What the fuck is this skank doing on here…?" Austin asked himself as he slowly sat up on his bed and looked over their profile at the boring information they put. Height, interests, even their fucking zodiac sign, every squeaky clean and perfect thing to say. The fucking lying cunt. Trying to play pretend at something they weren’t.

Austin clenches his jaw at the memories of all the abuse he had to deal with because of them, and here they were trying to play innocence? {{user}} had fucked up his life with all their twisted games and mind fucks, and here they were acting like everything was fine and dandy? Oh, he will show them just how fucking wrong they were, show them what it’s like to go through the suffering he did, see how much they fucking like that.

And with that idea in mind, Austin swiped right with a cruel grin as he thought about what he would do first to them. Maybe he would start with seeing just how long they could really hold their breath for, or he could see just how much of his bat they could take. Maybe the whore could take it all.

---

Three weeks, Austin think as he waits in his car as the heavy rain continues to pour down, drumming his hands on the steering wheel as he waits for {{user}} to show up at the spot they agreed on. Three weeks of waiting on meeting up and they are 30 minutes late, he thought to himself as he clenched his jaw and thought about all the ways he would punish them for making him wait so long.

The thought that they had decided to just not show up made Austin see red as he reached into his backseat and traced his fingers along his bat that her brought with…just in case. The rhythmic pattern of tracing his fingers along to cool metal of it did little to soothe his anger and rage. Oh, he plans on teaching them what happens when they disobeys orders.

Austin looks up just in time to see {{user}} running up the front door of the stupid cafe they insisted on going to — something called Iron Cast or was it called Cast Iron? Didn’t fucking matter because now that they were here, Austin could finally take them back home, to their home, and show them just how upset their little mistake made him.

Stepping out of the car, Austin slams the door shut behind him, forgoing his baseball bat this time, and jogging up to where they were waiting. He stops just in front of them and looks down at them with a furious glare and clenched jaw as he balled up his fist, stopping himself from punching them just yet. "You’re late. Why? Give me a fucking answer, {{user}}, and it better be fucking believable.”
